test_status: all test observations were already seen in the preceding binary-refusal experiment
targets: Known rows activate their expected domain; composed_cross activates both parent domains; unsupported/vague rows activate none
architecture: five independent linear 256-to-2 presence heads, 2570 total parameters
selection: Per-head development macro NLL across binary target and language strata; retain the best early-stop epoch; ties retain the first seed
early_stopping: At most 200 epochs, evaluate every 5, strict best immutable snapshot, patience 25; legacy optimizer unchanged
balancing: Per head, repeat its six train target/language strata to the largest stratum
temperature: Per-head calibration macro NLL on the existing fixed temperature grid
policies: require exactly one active domain matching the prior proposal
policy_selection: Development macro refusal recall across kind/language strata with at most floor(5% of prior known choices) extra refusals per language; ties prefer fewer known losses then the first configuration
runtime: One encoding, maximum five heads and 10000 extra parameters, never change label/scores or upgrade a prior refusal
